backup.production_rule: Expand only: the airbnb_email_events_email_type_check constraint is dropped and re-added with one more allowed value ('message'). No column, no data change; every existing row already satisfies the wider check. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, re-read the clock, then fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs does it). Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: email_type_check_allows_message_and_the_three_old_types
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(convalidated) and bool_and(pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%message%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%payout%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%booking%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%cancellation%') from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.airbnb_email_events'::regclass and conname = 'airbnb_email_events_email_type_check'

forward_verification.name: every_existing_event_has_one_of_the_four_types
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 0 from public.airbnb_email_events where email_type not in ('payout', 'booking', 'cancellation', 'message')

forward_verification.name: event_table_columns_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select string_agg(column_name, ',' order by ordinal_position) = 'id,property_id,gmail_message_id,email_type,email_date,subject,raw_payload,processed_at,created_at' from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'airbnb_email_events'

forward_verification.name: guest_save_is_still_an_allowed_pending_kind
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.telegram_pending'::regclass and contype = 'c' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%guest_save%'

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Redeploy the previous airbnb-email-sync first (it is the only writer of 'message' rows), then apply supabase/rollbacks/20261006_airbnb_message_events.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it deletes the message log rows (counts only, no text) and restores the three-type check.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_function_then_apps_script
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release BEFORE the new airbnb-email-sync is deployed (a message event would fail the old CHECK), and deploy the Apps Script patch (docs/gas/AirbnbEmailSync-message.patch.gs) LAST, after the function is live. Until Lloyd pastes the patch nothing sends a message event, so the release is dormant.

compatibility.rehearsal: PENDING: run the pgTAP suite airbnb_message_events (11 tests) and the 4 forward checks on a restored backup of the final commit.
compatibility.evidence: Production read-only (2026-10-06): airbnb_email_events_email_type_check is CHECK (email_type = ANY (ARRAY['payout','booking','cancellation'])); columns id, property_id, gmail_message_id, email_type, email_date, subject, raw_payload, processed_at, created_at; telegram_pending_kind_check already lists guest_save, so no new pending kind is needed. Old writers send only the three old types.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not run the pgTAP suite green on this commit
the new airbnb-email-sync is deployed before this release is applied
